decision.explanation: The question asks for the launch date of 'the Adriatic'. The source documents describe three distinct ships named 'Adriatic' (or 'RMS/SS Adriatic'), each with a unique launch date found in the text: 1) RMS Adriatic (1906) launched on 20 September 1906 (D1S5); 2) SS Adriatic (1871) launched on 17 October 1871 (D2S3, D3S1); and 3) Adriatic (1811 ship) launched in 1811 (D4S5). Since the question does not specify which vessel, all three distinct valid dates must be retained as complementary answers corresponding to distinct referents.
